mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) that increase the risk of denosumab-related adverse effects including hypocalcemia and ONJ.
action: Monitor serum calcium, magnesium, potassium, and renal function closely; consider delaying denosumab until amphotericin B therapy is completed; ensure aggressive electrolyte repletion and maintain adequate calcium/vitamin D supplementation.
